talking_points: Going well: the cache design doc, clearest this year; two teams reused the trade-offs table.
What happened: in the last two reviews, the risks came after a 20-minute demo.
Effect: risks surfaced in the final five minutes, and the decision slipped a week.
Ask: how did those reviews feel from your side? (Listen.)
Try next: open with the decision needed and the top three risks, then demo.
Check in: after the 3 Dec review. Offer to look at the agenda beforehand.
body: Thanks for the conversation today. To recap: your cache design doc set a new bar, and two teams have already reused the trade-offs table.
For the next design reviews, we agreed you'll open with the decision you need and the top three risks, then demo, so reviewers can weigh in while there's time.
Happy to look at the agenda before the 3 December review. Let's compare notes after it.
subject: Recap: design reviews
